name: AIUsage
description: One dashboard to manage all your AI subscriptions — track quotas, costs, accounts, Claude Code proxy, and Codex proxy in one place.
readme_summary: AIUsage is a macOS application designed to centralize the management of various AI subscriptions. It provides a unified dashboard to track usage, costs, and accounts across numerous AI providers, offering integrated proxies and gateways for seamless interaction with different AI models.
key_features: Unified dashboard for 12+ AI providers (Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, etc.)
Multi-account management with independent refresh and one-click CLI switching
Detailed usage statistics including cost and token breakdown
Claude Code Proxy for using various models with Claude Code
Claude Desktop Gateway for connecting Claude node pools to Claude Desktop
Codex Proxy for routing Codex CLI to OpenAI-compatible upstreams
OpenCode Proxy for switching OpenCode across different protocols and upstreams
Claude Science Proxy for launching local Claude Science with third-party model inference
primary_use_case: Managing and monitoring multiple AI service subscriptions and their usage from a single, convenient dashboard on macOS.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing and cataloging an immense, glowing library filled with countless books, each representing a different AI service subscription. The librarian uses a magical magnifying glass to track usage statistics and costs displayed as shimmering numbers above each book. In the background, subtle streams of data flow between different sections of the library, symbolizing the integrated proxies and gateways. The scene is set in a cozy, dimly lit study with warm, inviting light, emphasizing control and clarity. Small, stylized UI elements resembling a dashboard are subtly integrated into the library's architecture. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, organized composition and a color palette of deep blues, warm golds, and soft whites, evoking a sense of order and comprehensive management.

name: SILENTCHAIN
description: AI-powered vulnerability scanner extension for Burp Suite with multi-provider support (Ollama, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
readme_summary: SILENTCHAIN AI™ Community Edition is a Burp Suite extension that integrates AI models for passive vulnerability analysis of web application HTTP traffic. It identifies OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations in real-time, offering features like multi-AI provider support and data sanitization.
key_features: Multi-AI Support (Burp AI, Ollama, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure)
primary_use_case: To enhance web application security testing by providing AI-driven passive vulnerability detection within Burp Suite.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital librarian meticulously examining a stream of incoming data scrolls, each scroll representing a web request. The librarian uses a magnifying glass that glows with AI energy, revealing hidden symbols of vulnerabilities (like small red warning signs) within the text of the scrolls. Successfully scanned scrolls are marked with a green checkmark and flow into a secure vault labeled 'SILENTCHAIN'. Subtle UI elements showing AI confidence scores and vulnerability types are visible on a nearby holographic display. The scene is set in a futuristic, clean library with a cool blue and green color palette, emphasizing clarity and security. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clear iconography and a professional, trustworthy feel.

name: deep-eye
description: Deep Eye orchestrates multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Claude, Grok, Gemini, OLLAMA, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, LM Studio) for intelligent payload generation, scans targets for 45+ vulnerability types, and produces professional reports with compliance mapping.
readme_summary: Deep Eye is an advanced AI-driven penetration testing tool that orchestrates multiple AI providers for intelligent payload generation. It scans targets for over 50 vulnerability types and generates professional reports with compliance mapping, deduplication, and retest workflows.
key_features: Multi-AI Provider Support (11 providers with failover)
50+ Vulnerability Checks (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, JWT deep, IDOR, GraphQL deep, CORS/CSP, supply-chain JS, etc.)
Context-Aware Payloads (WAF fingerprint, tech stack, CVE-aware generation)
AI Triage & Evidence (FP filtering, evidence summaries)
Compliance Mapping (PCI-DSS v4, SOC2 CC, ISO 27001:2022)
Multiple Export Formats (HTML, PDF, JSON, SARIF, JUnit, CSV, XLSX)
primary_use_case: Automated, AI-enhanced penetration testing and vulnerability scanning with intelligent payload generation and professional reporting.
cover_image_prompt: A highly intelligent, multi-faceted AI 'detective' wearing a trench coat made of glowing code, meticulously examining a digital cityscape. The detective holds a magnifying glass that reveals hidden vulnerabilities represented as red, glitching symbols within buildings. Different AI provider logos (like OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) subtly float around the detective as 'assistants'. The cityscape itself is composed of interconnected data streams and network nodes, with some nodes clearly marked as 'secure' (green) and others as 'vulnerable' (red). The overall mood is one of advanced security and proactive threat detection, rendered in a sleek, futuristic digital painting style with a dark, high-contrast color palette.

name: OpenDocs
readme_summary: OpenDocs is a Python tool that automatically converts GitHub READMEs, Markdown files, and Jupyter Notebooks into a variety of professional documentation formats. It leverages AI to generate outputs like technical reports, executive decks, PDFs, blog posts, Jira tickets, academic papers, and even interactive knowledge graphs.
key_features: Converts READMEs, Markdown, and Jupyter Notebooks
Creates technical reports, executive decks, blog posts, Jira tickets, academic papers, social cards, FAQs, analysis reports, and more
Generates architecture diagrams and Mermaid diagrams
Extracts entities for knowledge graphs and interactive visualizations
Provides LLM summaries for different stakeholder views
Includes interactive knowledge graph with search, filtering, community detection, and provenance labels
Exports graph data as queryable JSON
Generates a knowledge wiki from Markdown files
primary_use_case: Automated generation of diverse documentation formats from source files like READMEs, Markdown, and Jupyter Notebooks.
cover_image_prompt: A magical, ornate book lies open on a wooden desk. From its pages, streams of digital light flow outwards, transforming into various professional documents: a crisp Word document, a sleek PowerPoint slide, a formal PDF report, and a glowing interactive graph. A small, stylized robot hand is shown gently guiding the light streams. The background is a softly lit library or study, with subtle code snippets and data visualizations appearing on nearby shelves. The overall mood is one of effortless creation and transformation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette and clear, defined elements.

name: liteparse
description: A fast, helpful, and open-source document parser
readme_summary: LiteParse is a fast, open-source document parsing tool written in Rust, designed for efficient local processing of PDFs and other document types. It extracts text with bounding boxes, supports multiple OCR engines, generates screenshots, and outputs structured Markdown, JSON, or plain text, making it suitable for RAG pipelines and LLM agents.
key_features: Flexible OCR System (Tesseract, HTTP Servers, Custom)
Bounding Boxes for Precise Text Positioning
Worker Pool Mode for Parallel Processing
primary_use_case: Efficiently extracting structured text and spatial information from documents locally, primarily for use in LLM agents and RAG pipelines.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent librarian in a quiet, modern library, meticulously organizing scattered pages from various documents (PDFs, images) into neat, structured stacks of text and digital blueprints. The librarian uses a magnifying glass that highlights text with glowing bounding boxes and a small, integrated screen showing OCR results. Digital particles representing extracted data flow from the pages into a central, glowing 'LiteParse' logo. The background features subtle code snippets and data visualizations. The scene is rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, organized color palette, emphasizing clarity and efficiency.
